method.gaussian_support: exact-MPR membership at probability at least 0.5
method.support_confidence: Wilson 95 percent lower confidence bound of shared Gaussian support normalized by the smaller proposal support
method.reciprocal_endpoint: per-target-view reciprocal best plus minimum of association probability and Gaussian-support LCB
method.strict_endpoint: complete reciprocal triangle spanning three source views plus the minimum association and Gaussian-support LCB across all three edges
method.unknown: unidirectional pair, partial boundary shell, single-view support, incomplete triangle, or zero shared Gaussian support

gate.purity_requirement: material improvement over soft association on source-heldout edges
gate.coverage_requirement: nonzero coverage in every source scene and no scene-level collapse
gate.coverage_result: fail: waldo_kitchen collapses to zero for both reciprocal and strict endpoints
gate.decision: reject current conservative core; do not build a figurines posterior and do not request another benchmark pilot

conclusion: The conservative core removes every observed false positive on ramen and teatime, so mutual Gaussian support is a valid precision signal. It is not a deployable authority because Waldo has no heldout DINO-positive edge that is simultaneously reciprocal and shares thresholded exact-MPR Gaussian support. The next prerequisite is denser source proposal coverage or correspondence-lifted probabilistic Gaussian support that preserves uncertainty; relaxing reciprocal or visibility evidence after this result would merely trade the diagnosed purity problem back for coverage and is not justified.
